decisions.reason: The 518 FLEX trommel screen builds on an established and well-liked screening machine at the core of the mobile portfolio, so its results likely meet the aspiration and the firm has no reason to search for other uses of its resources.

The flail shredder line fits the mobile-processing core, but it is not visible on the website after 2019, which adds uncertainty, so the firm keeps it while watching whether it falls short of the aspiration.
The mobile grinder line overlaps with the green-waste grinder and had low visibility, so pressure to consolidate is rising, but without a clear shortfall the firm keeps it for now.
Green waste and composting are core customer segments, so the firm keeps the grinder line despite its low visibility and possible overlap with Product C.

The single-shaft pre-shredders serve the stationary plant business, and without evidence of a performance shortfall the firm keeps carrying them, although tighter slack makes the line a candidate for later review.
